India seeks UN report on Pakistan's actions in PoK

India has requested the UN Human Rights Council to investigate and report on Pakistan's actions and human rights situation in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK). India also urged the UN Human Rights Bodies to end politicization and rejected claims made in a forest rights report.
